# forbaska.css — full reference

> Shared CSS design system for small single-page tools (forms, lists, tables, planning sheets). Plain CSS, no build step, `forbaska-` namespace.

Do not redesign the visual language into generic Tailwind/SaaS conventions. Preserve the rough, editorial, production-oriented character even when implementing standard UI components.

## Usage

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://forbaska.github.io/css/v1/forbaska.css">
```

- No build step, no framework required. Use `forbaska-` classes and `var(--forbaska-*)` tokens.
- Never hardcode colors, spacing, radius or fonts. Use tokens.
- Do not add Tailwind, Bootstrap or other CSS frameworks alongside it.
- Light/dark follows the system setting (`prefers-color-scheme`). Never add a manual theme that fights this, and never use hardcoded colors that break in dark mode.
- Page-specific CSS is fine, but build it from tokens and follow the principles below.

## Design principles

- Professional, not corporate. Raw, not messy. Minimal, with clear personality. Slightly challenging. Function first: used for small tools, forms, lists, planning.
- Clear enough that any user can use it without explanation.
- Base is warm off-white (light) or near-black (dark). Text is near-black / off-white, never blue-grey.
- Orange (`--forbaska-color-accent`) is a sparse signal color: primary action, active state, one highlight per view. Not a general theme color.
- Hard, visible borders matter more than shadows. When shadows are used they are hard and graphic (`--forbaska-shadow-hard`), never soft or blurred.
- Radius is minimal: 0–5px. Default is 0–2px.
- Typography is compact and editorial. Big headings are tightly set. Use monospace for metadata, timecodes, labels, statuses, IDs. Use uppercase labels, small markers and numbering as visual devices.
- Avoid: large soft cards, big border-radius, blue/purple gradients, glassmorphism, airy marketing sections, generic startup aesthetics, `rounded-xl shadow-sm bg-card` patterns.
- Avoid gimmicks and themed decoration: no film reels, clapperboard icons or cinematic gradients. Character comes from typography, structure, metadata and rhythm.
- Test for every component: could this only have been made for this specific small, uncompromising design profile, or does it look like a random SaaS template? If the latter, simplify and make it more editorial.

## Tokens (CSS custom properties on :root)

Color: `--forbaska-color-bg`, `-surface`, `-surface-strong`, `-text`, `-text-muted`, `-text-faint`, `-border`, `-border-soft`, `-accent`, `-accent-hover`, `-accent-soft`, `-on-accent`, `-success`, `-warning`, `-danger`
Font: `--forbaska-font-sans` (Arial Narrow stack), `--forbaska-font-mono`
Font size: `--forbaska-font-size-xs` .75rem, `-sm` .875, `-md` 1, `-lg` 1.25, `-xl` 1.75, `-2xl` 2.5, `-3xl` 4
Line height: `--forbaska-line-height-tight` .95, `-heading` 1.05, `-body` 1.45
Weight: `--forbaska-font-weight-normal|medium|bold|black`
Letter spacing: `--forbaska-letter-spacing-tight|normal|wide`
Spacing: `--forbaska-space-1` .25rem, `-2` .5, `-3` .75, `-4` 1, `-5` 1.5, `-6` 2, `-7` 3, `-8` 4, `-9` 6
Border: `--forbaska-border-width` 1px, `-strong` 2px, `-brutal` 4px
Radius: `--forbaska-radius-none|sm|md|lg|pill`
Shadow: `--forbaska-shadow-none`, `--forbaska-shadow-hard`, `--forbaska-shadow-hard-sm`
Layout: `--forbaska-content-width` 72rem, `--forbaska-content-width-narrow` 48rem, `--forbaska-page-gutter`
Interaction: `--forbaska-transition-fast` 100ms, `-medium` 180ms, `--forbaska-focus-ring`
Z-index: `--forbaska-z-base|raised|overlay|modal`

## Base styles

Applied to plain elements, no class needed: body (bg/text/font), `h1`–`h4` (black weight, tight letter-spacing; h4 is an uppercase label), `a` (underlined, accent on hover), `hr`, `code`/`kbd`/`samp` (mono), `::selection` (accent), focus ring on `:focus-visible`.

## Layout classes

- `forbaska-container` — centered, max `--forbaska-content-width`, page gutters. `forbaska-container--narrow` for forms and reading.
- `forbaska-section` — vertical padding; consecutive sections get a 2px divider.
- `forbaska-stack` — vertical flex, gap 1rem. Modifiers `forbaska-stack--sm`, `forbaska-stack--lg`.
- `forbaska-row` — horizontal flex, wraps, centered. Modifiers `forbaska-row--between`, `forbaska-row--end`.
- `forbaska-grid` — responsive auto-fill grid, min 16rem columns.
- `forbaska-header` — top bar with a 4px bottom border.
- `forbaska-sr-only` — visually hidden, available to screen readers.

```html
<header class="forbaska-header"><div class="forbaska-container forbaska-row forbaska-row--between">
  <strong>Tool name</strong><span class="forbaska-meta">v1 · 2026-09-26</span>
</div></header>
<main class="forbaska-container forbaska-container--narrow forbaska-section forbaska-stack forbaska-stack--lg">…</main>
```

## Typography classes

- `forbaska-meta` — small uppercase mono, muted. For labels, timecodes, statuses, metadata.
- `forbaska-mono` — monospace text. `forbaska-num` — mono with tabular numerals (times, counts, columns of numbers).
- `forbaska-muted` — muted text color. `forbaska-accent` — accent text color (sparingly).

```html
<p class="forbaska-meta">Scene 04 · 12:30–14:00</p>
<h1>Call sheet</h1>
```

## Buttons

`forbaska-btn` on `<button>` or `<a>`. Uppercase, 2px border, hard small shadow, presses down on click.
Variants: `forbaska-btn--primary` (orange, one per view), `forbaska-btn--ghost` (no fill/shadow), `forbaska-btn--danger`, `forbaska-btn--sm`. Disable with `disabled` or `aria-disabled="true"`.

```html
<button class="forbaska-btn forbaska-btn--primary">Save</button>
<button class="forbaska-btn">Cancel</button>
<a class="forbaska-btn forbaska-btn--ghost" href="…">Back</a>
```

## Forms

- `forbaska-field` — wrapper: label, control, hint/error stacked.
- `forbaska-label` — small uppercase mono label. `forbaska-hint` — helper text. `forbaska-error-text` — error message.
- `forbaska-input`, `forbaska-select`, `forbaska-textarea` — square, 2px border. Mark errors with `aria-invalid="true"`.
- `forbaska-check` — wraps a checkbox or radio `<input>` plus label text; custom square/round box with accent mark.

```html
<div class="forbaska-field">
  <label class="forbaska-label" for="name">Name</label>
  <input class="forbaska-input" id="name" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="name-err">
  <span class="forbaska-error-text" id="name-err">Required</span>
</div>
<label class="forbaska-check"><input type="checkbox"> Confirmed</label>
```

## Card, badge, alert

- `forbaska-card` — surface with 2px border, small padding. `forbaska-card--raised` adds hard shadow. `a.forbaska-card` is a clickable card that lifts on hover.
- `forbaska-badge` — small uppercase mono tag with border. Variants: `forbaska-badge--accent`, `--success`, `--warning`, `--danger`. Use for statuses.
- `forbaska-alert` — block with a thick left border. Variants: `forbaska-alert--info` (accent), `--success`, `--warning`, `--danger`.

```html
<span class="forbaska-badge forbaska-badge--success">Confirmed</span>
<div class="forbaska-alert forbaska-alert--warning">Two people have not replied.</div>
```

## Table

Wrap in `forbaska-table-wrap` (horizontal scroll, border) and put `forbaska-table` on the table. Header cells are uppercase mono. Row hover uses `--forbaska-color-accent-soft`. Use `forbaska-num` on numeric cells.

```html
<div class="forbaska-table-wrap"><table class="forbaska-table">
  <thead><tr><th>Time</th><th>Item</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody><tr><td class="forbaska-num">09:00</td><td>Setup</td><td><span class="forbaska-badge">Open</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table></div>
```

## Index list

`ol.forbaska-index` — auto-numbered list (01, 02, 03) with strong dividers. Each `li` is a 3-column grid: number, main content (usually a link), trailing metadata.

```html
<ol class="forbaska-index">
  <li><a href="…">Item title</a><span class="forbaska-meta">12 entries</span></li>
</ol>
```

## Checklist for a new page

1. `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` and the stylesheet link.
2. Content in `forbaska-container` / `forbaska-section`; layout with `forbaska-stack`, `forbaska-row`, `forbaska-grid`.
3. Only one `forbaska-btn--primary` per view. Orange elsewhere is rare.
4. Labels for every input; errors via `aria-invalid` plus `forbaska-error-text`.
5. Check both light and dark, keyboard focus and a phone-width viewport.
6. No hardcoded colors, no soft shadows, no radius above 5px.
